# Scale Enterprises

> Scale Enterprises is an enterprise scaling and development firm that helps US service-business owners take control of their businesses. We Design, Engineer, and Lead an enterprise-level business that scales and runs without the owner, using enterprise strategy, strong leadership and accountability systems, all enabled with AI. Founder: Matthew Landon. Not affiliated with Scale AI.

## Who it's for
- Owners of service businesses doing $500K+ in annual revenue who want the business to run without them.

## How it works
- Design: enterprise-level strategy and org design.
- Engineer: systems, operations and AI-enabled workflows.
- Lead: leadership and accountability systems.
